title: GT data and review authoring need richer operator tooling and stricter schema alignment

original_titles.title: weight_multiplier (patch R-31) missing from the bug model

problem: A minimal GT bug-create UI and flag CRUD UI now exist, and flag secrets are not returned. However, the bug page lacks full GT read/edit/revision and preview workflows. Schema concepts such as weight_multiplier, typed origin, canonical fields and alternative-location aliases remain deviated from the referenced spec.
impact: Organizers cannot confidently inspect and revise the complete GT dataset through an auditable UI. Schema divergence can make score semantics or export contracts ambiguous.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Resolve the normative data model with the event owner: canonical file, locations/anchors, award unit, root-cause group, origin, weight multiplier, aliases and test-case fields.
Create migration/model changes with explicit CHECK constraints and foreign keys; preserve historical GT revisions rather than editing frozen versions in place.
Add GT bug list/detail/edit/version compare and change reason UI, plus an audit-on-view record for sensitive answer-key data.
Add dry-run matchability and overlap preview using the same matcher version as the evaluator.
Add schema conformance tests and fixture import tests that fail if any seeded anchor/path is missing or silently skipped.

acceptance_criteria: Every GT entry is readable and editable through the approved authoring flow before freeze.
Schema constraints match the accepted spec or a written waiver.
Freeze fails on missing/invalid anchors and records a validation report.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
